addition.item: Joomla now shows this changelog for each update in System - Update - Extensions and in Extensions - Manage.

fix.item: Add the GPL licence notice to the PHP files of Add accounts to groups, as JED Checker requires.

note.item: The build check now fails if any distributed PHP file lacks the licence notice.

addition.item: Synchronise a group branch: adjust the groups of one branch from a list, as a partial update or a complete list, with review, confirmation and resumable batches.
Hand over content and close an account: move the authorship of chosen articles to another active account, then open the block or anonymisation review.

change.item: Anonymise accounts: the result reports separately the verified identity, the additional clean-up per source and the privacy plugins that cannot be verified.
Explain content access only lists the menu items the operator can see.
CSV exports neutralise every cell that a spreadsheet could run as a formula.

fix.item: The selection counter uses the singular for one account.

language.item: New Spanish and British English strings for the new tools and guided tours.
